ns2:section.sectionText: This course will read chiefly prose fiction, but also poetry, memoiristic literature and selected journalism issuing from Russia at war from earliest times to the recent conflicts in the Caucasus. It will also treat a selection of war films and offer exposure to other aspects of popular culture such as songs and propaganda posters. The course will be weighted toward treatment of the twentieth century, and in particular, the Russian Civil War period and World War IIøthe most mythologized and culturally significant conflicts for Russian and Soviet culture of the past century. Open to non-majors and students who do not read Russian.
